readerCopy.body: Helping someone else can quietly become an attempt to repair an old ending that still feels unfinished. When Neptune conjoins Chiron, compassion and sensitivity fuse, making another person's grief, confusion, illness, or disappointment feel familiar enough that rescue starts carrying personal meaning. The care can be sincere while the helper becomes attached to controlling the outcome. Support stays healthier when the other person's ending is not asked to repair an earlier one.
